title: The Line Holds (Bifrost Sync)
style: epic cinematic, male choir lead, female ethereal chorus, 84 BPM, orchestral strings, taiko drums, ceremonial, foundation-anthem, last-stand, mythic, sovereign, line-of-the-watch
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Bifrost sync state, zynrip foundation laid
Mac to VDS to gdrive to vault, the path well made
R2 skipped because full, the bucket overflowed
Proton pending bridge password, the last node owed

[Pre-Chorus]
Six way mirror pattern, every doc redundant
Incident docs and handover already abundant

[Chorus]
The line holds, the line holds, three three six the call
Bifrost sync the foundation when the lanes all fall
The line holds, the line holds, the mirrors all align
VDS to gdrive to vault, the redundancy is fine

[Verse 2]
Zynrip dot SH cron at oh three hundred nightly
Suno new tracks poll every fifteen minutes lightly
Bifrost sync version one one on the Mac alive
R2 aware and skipping when the bucket can't survive

[Bridge]
To complete a full zynrip right now from Mac
Bash bifrost sync and watch the mirrors stack
From VDS SSH into zynthio for the run
The handover already mirrored before the work was done

[Outro]
The line holds, three three six, the foundation is sound
The next lane builds the site or the silence comes around
